name: Mauritius
about: Brand colours, then the roles a theme is written in. Templates name roles, never colours. A role takes a brand colour by name or a hex for a neutral tint. No fitting role: add one here with its meaning, do not copy a hex from a neighbouring config. Applied by brand/tools/theme.py.

win.use: menus, tooltips, OSDs, the desktop-switch indicator: raised surfaces

title-on.use: active window title bar, menu title

text.use: all text: panel, surfaces, title bars; title-bar buttons

muted.use: secondary text: inactive titles, minimized windows

border.use: borders of the panel, buttons, menus, inactive windows

primary.use: action and focus: active window border, active markers

sel.use: selection background: active task, active desktop, menu item
